thread:
rina: Incoming pentest Wed 05/07. Quick plan thread: ephemeral RBAC, KMS evidence unwrap, audit slices, and retest rules. 20m sync?
omar: +1. Keep production untouched. Use staging tenant and replayable snapshots only.
devon: Proposal: 2-hour active window. Ephemeral roles via OIDC, session duration 90m. Roles: pt-view, pt-run. All sessions tagged pen_test=1755559999.
ops-bot: presigned role URLs ready for pt-view and pt-run. Will expire after session.
rina: KMS: create a temporary wrapper key alias/pt-wrap-1755559999. CreateGrant for decrypt scoped to prefix s3://pt-evidence/1755559999/* and with PrincipalTag pen_test=true. Revoke after window.
omar: Audit capture list: CloudTrail segment for window, S3 access logs, VPC flow logs for staging CIDR, and bastion session recordings. Provide SOC query snippets.
devon: Intake & remediation: create a single tracker board PT-INTAKE. Fields: severity, triage_owner, retest_required(boolean), evidence_links. Only tickets with retest_required=true can request a retest slot.
rina: Retest slots: reserve two 1.5h slots within 72h post-test. Vendor picks one; internal triage must validate fixes 24h prior.
omar: Redaction: run automated scrub for API keys/emails, then security review (2 eyes) before sharing. All external exports must be signed and have a redaction manifest.
ops-bot: created grant_id=gr-f1e2d3; audit_link=https://logs.internal/gr-f1e2d3. Scheduled revoke 2026-05-07T13:30:00Z.
devon: I'll upload RBAC CSV + policy diffs to s3://pt-artifacts/1755559999/ and post checksums.
rina: Owners: RBAC export/devon, KMS grants/ops, redaction/omar, jira & triage/rina.
ops-bot: all set: presigned links posted to secure channel. Remember to rotate vendor creds after revoke.
rina: thanks team. will open formal Jira tasks and tag owners. Post any last-minute blockers here.
